target: Install an authority document for read-only task-orchestrator operator integration readiness and mutation boundaries.
invariants: Do not modify runtime code, service code, tests, compose files, dependency files, provider configuration, or MCP launcher code.

Preserve Dopemux split authority boundaries: dopemux operator control, task-orchestrator workflow views/transitions, dopetask execution/proof, ConPort decisions/progress/context, dope-memory chronicle, dope-context retrieval, dopecon-bridge transport only.
Do not claim autonomous workflow mutation is ready.
Do not treat dopecon-bridge as canonical task, workflow, PM, decision, progress, memory, chronicle, retrieval, or proof authority.
Do not treat the upstream 13-tool MCP Task Orchestrator and the in-repo FastAPI task-orchestrator service as one unified runtime contract.
Preserve UNKNOWN where current repo evidence does not establish a canonical writer, proof envelope, consumer chain, schema winner, or agent authority.
No workflow transitions, GitHub mutations, memory writes, index writes, destructive actions, live provider calls, live extraction, Docker startup, or runtime health probes.

pr.title: docs(orchestrator): define read-only integration authority
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds an authority document for task-orchestrator operator integration readiness.
- Establishes read-only status, queue, blocker, and daily summary surfaces as the first safe integration lane.
- Defers workflow mutation, event consumers, GitHub automation, memory writes, and destructive/index actions until explicit proof and approval gates exist.

## Scope
Docs, packet index, task packet, proof allowlist, and proof only. No runtime, tests, compose, dependencies, provider config, MCP launcher, or live service changes.

## Validation
Include exact command outputs and exit codes for JSON syntax, task-packet schema validation, docs validator, docs frontmatter guard, proof JSON syntax, authority-grep checks, and git diff checks.

## NOT_RUN
- Runtime service health checks
- Docker startup
- Live provider calls
- Live extraction
- Workflow transitions or MCP write calls
- GitHub comments/labels/merge
- ConPort, dope-memory, or dope-context writes

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
List unresolved event-consumer, proof-envelope, schema, agent-authority, and Python/FastAPI-vs-upstream-MCP boundary risks.

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, branch, marker, clean status, active MCP work state, and required authority files.
validation: Worktree is isolated from the primary checkout.
Required authority files are present or missing authority is marked UNKNOWN.
MCP Task Orchestrator active, blocked, and stalled item state is recorded.

steps.task: Create and validate this Task Packet, then register it in task-packets/INDEX.md.

requirements: Convert the supplied draft into a formal authority document with OBSERVED, RISK, PROPOSED, and UNKNOWN labels.
Preserve the verdict: read-only/operator-status integration is allowed first; mutation-heavy orchestration is not ready.
Document system roles, authority boundaries, automation tiers, proposed CLI/MCP surfaces, memory write policy, staged rollout, and open questions.
Correct unsupported claims instead of repeating them as fact; especially distinguish the in-repo FastAPI service from the upstream 13-tool MCP runtime.
Use ASCII-only formal authority language; omit jokes, emoji, and non-authority metaphors.
